scope: Audit 16 external images in the rendered textbook, replace three embeds with source figures whose reuse is established, and exclude the unlicensed local copy of the ReAct project image. Verify the source bytes and license of twelve older D2L images. Preserve original links, examples and archive files.

review.reading: Figure-scoped revision. Prior whole-chapter reading receipts match both archived chapter inputs exactly. Reviewed the changed sections and neighboring explanations against primary sources; read the complete Agentic learning overview and preserved unrelated sections. The chapter programs and JSON examples are unchanged.
review.workedExamples: ReAct uses Obs 2 to refine Front Row to Front Row (software). RepairAgent can return from a failed patch to information gathering or hypothesis revision. AgentTrek Figure 4 distinguishes 68.8M prefiltered records, 54M after FastText and 18.8M after deduplication; the linked replay example requires finding the correct product-category return policy, not merely opening a page.
review.sourceAndRights: ReAct paper v3 Figure 1(1), CC BY 4.0, is distinct from the project PNG. RepairAgent v2 Figure 2, CC BY 4.0, and AgentTrek v2 Figure 4, CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, match upstream bytes. AgentTrek Figure 5 shows an actual third-party storefront and logos. Source article license is not a clearance for separately owned components.
review.transport: All 16 previously embedded URLs responded HTTP 200 with an image media type in the initial probe. All 13 remaining external URLs decoded in a browser. In the static scan of 310 textbook pages across both editions, no registered image bytes mismatch, no retired images render and no KaTeX errors appear. The literal project PNG is absent from the output asset tree.
review.d2l: Ten SVGs match the files served by their author chapters. LeNet and ResNet-18 instead match the exact repository tag v1.0.3 (b2e2ae30898a9d0126a9699ae7e441de3e272715), where they are the vertical and unrotated originals respectively. The tagged CC BY-SA 4.0 license matches the archived license bytes. No figure or chapter bytes changed.
review.renderedReview: ReAct, RepairAgent and AgentTrek checked in the Russian edition and canonical fallbacks at 1280 and 375 px. RepairAgent labels are readable inline at the narrow width. ReAct and AgentTrek's small labels need the working zoom viewer on mobile. No page-width overflow or figure aspect-ratio change. The English shell of the research overview links to the canonical Russian ReAct example.
review.verification: The final root build produced 2075 pages. The link checker found no broken internal routes, fragments or files; 290 rendered-output tests, 769 publication tests (13 skips) and 588 source-evidence tests passed. Both agent example checkers passed without running an LLM or browser agent. The rendered textbook scan matches 1170 SHA-256 values across 1214 distinct local image paths.
review.remaining: 44 older rendered paths still lack SHA-256 and 13 external embeds still need a reuse decision. The licensed Self-Refine v2 and tau-bench v1 papers and the AWS Generative AI Atlas documentation are candidates for relevant replacements in the orchestration and evaluation chapters. Verify the exact figure and any third-party components before reuse.
review.publication: Local only. No commit, push or deployment.

[![Reason-only, Act-only и ReAct: рассуждение и обратная связь от среды](https://react-lm.github.io/files/diagram.png)](https://react-lm.github.io/files/diagram.png)

*Сравнение Reason-only, Act-only и ReAct. Источник: Shunyu Yao et al.,
[ReAct project page](https://react-lm.github.io/), рисунок `diagram.png`.*

В первом режиме модель строит текстовое рассуждение без нового внешнего
наблюдения. Во втором явно выдаёт действия, но промежуточные текстовые
рассуждения не включены в траекторию. ReAct чередует оба типа шагов.
Отсутствие видимого текста между вызовами не доказывает, что у современной
модели нет внутреннего рассуждения; схема сравнивает форматы prompting

Первая панель исходного рисунка, с английскими подписями. [Сводная схема трёх циклов на сайте проекта](https://react-lm.github.io/files/diagram.png).* В столбце Reason-only модель строит рассуждение без нового внешнего наблюдения. В Act-only видны действия и ответы среды; промежуточный текст рассуждения не записан. В панели ReAct модель пишет `Thought` и `Act`, а среда возвращает `Obs`. Отсутствие видимого текста между вызовами не доказывает, что у современной модели нет внутреннего рассуждения; схема сравнивает форматы prompting
